if: a discount is given before or at the time of the supply
the discount has been duly recorded IN THE INVOICE issued in respect of that supply
then: the discount is EXCLUDED from the value of supply
note: Recording it in the invoice is a condition, not paperwork. A pre-supply discount agreed verbally and left off the invoice does not reduce the taxable value under this clause.

evidence.quote: The value of the supply shall not include any discount which is given
evidence.extraction_note: The sub-section ends '––' in the extraction. The quote stops before them.

evidence.quote: before or at the time of the supply if such discount has been duly recorded in the invoice issued in respect of such supply
